**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Finish the D2 auto-revert governance chain (issue #259) end to end, run the deterministic reviewer over the work, and keep the issue ledger honest.

## Instructions (owner preferences reinforced)
- The approval keystroke (`status:approved`) is ALWAYS the human's — the agent offers the exact `!gh` command and never self-applies, even on direct instruction (two-key split, ADR-0020). Same for `brain:review`: it refuses to run without `BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN` (a distinct reviewer identity), by design.
- Issues close when work lands on `feature/v2.0.0`, NOT when v2.0.0 reaches `main` (GitHub auto-close never fires because slice PRs target the non-default branch).
- Measure, never estimate. Verify merges by ancestry/tree, never trust the MERGED badge.
- Don't over-frame someone else's task as your own (the user corrected me when I built an action plan for #307, which wasn't mine).

## Discoveries
- **A source-scanning drift-guard matches its own teeth-sample string literals AND its own explanatory comments** — hit THREE times (PR4's D1, the `grep -c '^parent '` workflow comment, PR5's 5.4). Fixes: assemble the scanned token at runtime (`'spawn'+"Sync('bash'"`); skip comment lines in the scanner.
- **cursor.mjs is REMOTE-authoritative** (`git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/governance/audit-cursor`) — a self-contained test needs a bare origin with the ref pushed. Found a workflow bug this way: the ABSENT init message named the wrong ref.
- **`brain:review` (Subagent Executor Doctrine §13, from #306)**: a reviewer subagent is a pure executor of `npm run brain:review -- --pr <id>` — never a manual review. It needs `BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN`; `reviewer.handle` empty in brain.config.json means it posts as author (self-review, actor-check FAILURE).
- PR5's standing isolation guard (5.4) VALIDATED PR4's D1 fix — passing against the real suite proved PR4's born-isolated fixtures generalize.

## Accomplished
- **D2 CHAIN COMPLETE.** PR4 (#308, postmerge auto-revert executor — cursor-windowed, exit-code-branched, `[FAIL-SHA]`-consuming, born-isolated fixtures) MERGED (87d766a). PR5 (#311, exit-codes.mjs + run-check uncomputable wiring + exit-code-contract drift-guard + standing harness-isolation drift-guard) MERGED (1efd8d8). Full suite 1892/1892.
- Ran deterministic `brain:review`: PR4 #308 → APPROVE (editorial actor-check only); PR #307 (other agent's issue-305) → REVISE (issue #305 lacked the status:approved GitHub label).
- Took the other agent's issue-305 (3-axis decoupling) changes into memory; it later merged as #307.
- Closed #304 (PR4) and #310 (PR5) with ancestry evidence. #259/#297/#302 already closed.

## Next Steps
- **rung-3 auto-revert is fully live on feature/v2.0.0** — exit + isolation contracts guard-enforced end to end. No PR6.
- OWNER carryover: ROTATE `BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN` (pasted in transcript — compromised); set `reviewer.handle` in brain.config.json to a reviewer service account (distinct from csrinaldi) for real two-key posted verdicts.
- Still awaiting owner criteria: #266 (Track H ledger — reviewActors + size criterion), #217/#222/#247/#256 (memory/SDD judgment-gated closures).
- ~12 genuinely-unstarted issues (#280 #268 #267 #263 #210 #131 #130 #129 #124 #123 #117 #94) + #284 (reviewer v2, carries the verdict:BLOCKED schema debt).

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/exit-codes.mjs — the 0/1/2 contract (PR5)
- brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs — uncomputable wiring + resultToExit (PR5)
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/{exit-code-contract,harness-isolation}-drift-guard.test.mjs — PR5 standing guards
- .github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml — the D2 auto-revert executor (PR4)
- brain/scripts/vcs/release-postmerge-workflows.test.mjs — PR4 born-isolated workflow-extracting harness + fixtures
